meta.title: mindunder.dev: business process automation in London
meta.description: I find the work your team repeats by hand. Then I build a system that does it. The first step is a free 30-minute call. Based in London.

what.label: What I do
what.value: I look at how work moves through your business. I find the steps that people repeat by hand. Then I build software that does those steps for you.

firstStep.label: First step
firstStep.value: A free 30-minute call. Afterwards you get a one-page written summary of where time is lost. You keep it whether or not we work together.

cost.label: Cost
cost.missing: Prices are not published on this site yet. The first call is free. You can ask for a price by email.

clients.label: Client work
clients.missing: No client case studies are published yet. The examples on this site are systems I built and run for my own projects.

headline: I find the work your team repeats by hand.
Then I build a system that does it.
landing.lede: For example: copying data between systems, chasing approvals by email, or making the same report every week. I work alone, from London.

tool.label: Work out what repeated work costs you
tool.note: Type three numbers. It takes about one minute.

lens.idle: Illustration: a business process drawn as a network. Move your pointer to look underneath it. Click to scan the whole picture.
lens.idleTouch: Illustration: a business process drawn as a network. Move your finger across it to look underneath. Tap to scan the whole picture.
lens.found: Illustration: the circled point is a bottleneck, a place where work waits for a person.
